title: GitHub and collaboration
goal: Share a proposed change through a reviewable pull request.
explanation: Git is the version-control tool; GitHub hosts repositories and collaboration tools. A remote connects a local repository to a hosted one.
Use a branch for a focused change. Push it and open a pull request that explains the problem, resulting behaviour and checks performed.
Review the diff and automated checks before merging. Keep secrets out of issues, logs and screenshots. Resolve review feedback in context rather than rewriting unrelated code.
code:
git switch -c add-contact-page
# Edit, review and commit your files first.
git push -u origin add-contact-page
exercise: Draft a pull-request description for a responsive navigation fix, including how you tested it.
hint: State what users experienced before and after the change.

quiz.question: What is a pull request used for?
quiz.explanation: A pull request creates a place to discuss and review a branch before integration.
